question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

Happening repeatedly
solution:
The correct answer is '**Recurrent**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Recurrent**'.
 
• Let's look at the meaning of options:
 
 
• **Recuperate** - to recover from illness or exertion (उपचार करना / ठीक होना)
 
• **Recurrent** - happening repeatedly or frequently (बार-बार होनेवाला)
 
• **Rapport** - a close and harmonious relationship in which the people or groups concerned understand each other's feelings or ideas and communicate well (मिलनसारता / सबसे अच्छी दोस्ती)
 
• **Regression** - a return to a former or less developed state (प्रतिष्ठान / पीछे हटना) 
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option** 2) Recurrent.**
 
• In the given context, "**recurrent**" best describes something happening repeatedly. *For example, "The **recurrent** power outages in the area have caused inconvenience to the residents."*
